description: Independently hand-derived FIFO / wash-sale / holding-period known-answer scenario for qme.quant.tax_lots. Every expected amount below was derived from the registered rule text with exact rational arithmetic before the production module was executed; the module is only compared against these numbers, never used to produce them.
merge_note: Merging this bounded T1 candidate does NOT make it usable for blocker clearance. Before it can be bound into a T0 successor-freeze it must be included in a non-Claude review or independently recomputed by a qualifying human reviewer.

securities.AAA: Main FIFO / wash episode: multi-lot FIFO consumption, a full wash split across a before-replacement and an after-replacement, a prorated partial wash, a gain with a repurchase in the window, and a loss with no replacement.
securities.BBB: Forward-split security; also carries the exactly-365 (SHORT) and exactly-366 (LONG) holding-period boundary pair.
securities.WB30: Wash boundary probe: replacement acquired exactly 30 calendar days BEFORE the loss sale => INCLUDED.
securities.WB31: Wash boundary probe: replacement acquired exactly 31 calendar days BEFORE the loss sale => EXCLUDED.
securities.WA30: Wash boundary probe: replacement acquired exactly 30 calendar days AFTER the loss sale => INCLUDED.
securities.WA31: Wash boundary probe: replacement acquired exactly 31 calendar days AFTER the loss sale => EXCLUDED.
securities.CHN: Chained wash: lot A washes into lot B, then lot B (carrying the add-back basis and the tacked holding start) is itself sold at a loss and washes into lot C.

frozen_v0_1_tax_decisions.rate_scenario_note: The 0.24 case is NOT the owner's actual tax bracket. All three short-term rates are registered scenarios only and no scenario is claimed to be the filer's marginal rate.

registered_rules.split_rule: shares*ratio, basis unchanged, applied before same-day fills

rule_notes: Fees are added to basis on BUY and subtracted from proceeds on SELL.
A realized LOSS is disallowed to the extent shares of the same security are acquired within 30 calendar days before or after the sale; the sold shares themselves never replace their own loss.
The window is inclusive at both ends: an offset of exactly -30 or +30 calendar days is INSIDE the window; -31 or +31 is OUTSIDE it.
Partial replacement is prorated by shares; each replacement share can absorb only one wash, so a replacement lot's capacity is consumed as it absorbs losses.
A disallowed amount is added to the replacement lot's basis and the replacement lot's holding start tacks back to the sold lot's holding start (only when that start is earlier).
Adjusted basis and tacked holding start travel with the replacement lot, so a chain of successive replacements accumulates them.

Scenario tax: ST and LT netted separately after carry-in, then a net loss in one character offsets a net gain in the other; the residual net loss carries forward with its character; taxable = max(net, 0) per character after offset.

per_event_row_schema.description: One row per realized event, carrying the owner-mandated per-event field names. A field that does not apply to an event is present and null, never omitted.

conventions.replacement_fields_are_arrays: replacement_lot_id, replacement_date, replacement_offset_days, replacement_quantity, allocated_replacement_quantity, replacement_basis_before_adjustment, adjusted_replacement_basis, replacement_holding_period_start_before_adjustment and adjusted_holding_period_start are parallel arrays, one entry per replacement allocation in the order the allocations were made. They are null when the event has no replacement at all.
conventions.buy_fees: the purchase-fee component of original_basis for the quantity sold: the opening fill's fee pro-rated by the fraction of the lot consumed. It is 0.00000000 for a lot opened with no fee even when the lot's basis contains a wash add-back that itself included a fee (see event E14).
conventions.sell_fees: the sale fill's fee pro-rated by shares taken / shares sold. sell_proceeds is already net of it.
conventions.recognized_loss: the event's recognized amount when pre_wash_gain_or_loss < 0 (so <= 0, and exactly 0.00000000 for a fully washed loss); null for a gain.
conventions.original_holding_period_start: the holding start used to classify THIS sale. It equals acquisition_date unless the sold lot was itself a wash replacement, in which case it is the earlier tacked start - that is the chain evidence.
conventions.adjusted_holding_period_start: each replacement lot's holding start AFTER tacking.
conventions.estimated_scenario_tax: always null: the registered estimator nets ST and LT at YEAR level after carry-in and cross-offset, so no per-event tax exists. Attributing one would be a fabricated number. The year-level table is expected.scenario_tax and the event-to-year trace is expected.scenario_tax_composition.
conventions.tax_scenario: the registered scenario set the event's recognized amount flows into; 0.24 is NOT the owner's actual bracket.

status_codes.GAIN_NO_WASH_APPLICABLE: raw gain >= 0; the wash-sale rule does not apply to gains.
status_codes.LOSS_FULLY_DISALLOWED_WASH: every loss share was matched to a replacement share inside the window.
status_codes.LOSS_PARTIALLY_DISALLOWED_WASH: some loss shares were matched; the unmatched fraction stays recognized.
status_codes.LOSS_FULLY_RECOGNIZED_NO_REPLACEMENT_IN_: no replacement share was available inside the window; the whole loss is recognized.
status_codes.REPLACEMENT_BEFORE_SALE_WITHIN_WINDOW: allocation to a lot acquired on or after (sale_date - 30) and on or before the sale date.
status_codes.REPLACEMENT_AFTER_SALE_WITHIN_WINDOW: allocation to a lot acquired after the sale date and on or before (sale_date + 30).

cross_account_wash_sales.note: Replacement purchases made in any other account (including IRAs and a spouse's accounts) are not observable to this estimator and are NOT modelled. The effect is encoded as unavailable rather than as zero: any cross-account replacement would increase the disallowed loss, so every disallowed_loss figure here is a LOWER bound, every recognized_loss figure is an UPPER bound, and the strategy-account scope is a known UNDERSTATEMENT of wash-sale disallowance.

CHAINED wash: adjusted basis + tacked ho.evidence: CHN lot 13 -> lot 16 -> lot 17: event 14's basis 1380.30 is lot 16's adjusted basis and its holding start 2026-03-11 is lot 13's; lot 17 inherits both again

hand_worked.event: 2025 year-end netting (scenario only)
hand_worked.derivation: ST recognized (events 0,1,2,4) = 0.00 + (-110.00) + 90.00 + (-480.40) = -500.40; LT recognized (event 3) = +299.30. The net ST loss offsets the net LT gain: offset = min(500.40, 299.30) = 299.30, leaving ST -201.10 and LT 0.00. Taxable ST = max(-201.10, 0) = 0.00, taxable LT = 0.00, so tax = 0.00 at every registered rate. Residual ST loss carries forward: -201.10.

fail_closed_inputs.name: oversell
fail_closed_inputs.reason: selling 15 shares out of a 10-share position must fail closed, not net to zero

fail_closed_inputs.name: sell_unknown_security
fail_closed_inputs.reason: a sale of a security with no open lot has no basis and must not default to zero basis

fail_closed_inputs.name: non_positive_shares
fail_closed_inputs.reason: a zero-share fill is not a valid lot event

fail_closed_inputs.name: negative_fees
fail_closed_inputs.reason: a negative fee would silently manufacture proceeds

fail_closed_inputs.name: hifo_requested_without_verified_election
fail_closed_inputs.reason: v0.1 is FIFO-only: a HIFO request must fail closed unless a verified account-election artifact exists, so no HIFO election is ever claimed.

nonclaims: No Freeze V4 blocker is cleared by this fixture; NEE-116-TAX-LOT-IMPLEMENTATION-EVIDENCE remains ACTIVE and the blocker count is unchanged.
Synthetic scenario with invented securities AAA/BBB/WB30/WB31/WA30/WA31/CHN; no production or market data is used.
No actual tax liability is estimated: the figures are registered rate scenarios only and 0.24 is NOT the owner's actual bracket.
No HIFO account election is claimed; hifo_enabled is false and the module rejects HIFO without a verified election artifact.
Cross-account wash sales are excluded and may cause understatement of disallowed loss; they are encoded as UNAVAILABLE_OUT_OF_SCOPE, not as zero.
Ordinary-income capital-loss deduction, state tax, NIIT and dividend taxation are out of scope.
Same-Claude-lineage review is internal QA only; external independent acceptance remains required before any T0 binding.

reason_codes.FIFO_OLDEST_ACQUIRED_FIRST: the consumed lot was chosen by FIFO: oldest acquisition first, lot id as tiebreak.
reason_codes.SOLD_LOT_CARRIES_TACKED_HOLDING_START_FR: the SOLD lot's holding start is earlier than its own acquisition because it was itself a wash replacement; that tacked start classifies this sale.
reason_codes.GAIN_NOT_SUBJECT_TO_WASH_SALE_RULE: pre_wash_gain_or_loss >= 0, so the wash-sale rule does not apply.
reason_codes.REPLACEMENT_BEFORE_SALE_WITHIN_WINDOW: at least one replacement lot was acquired within 30 days before the sale.
reason_codes.REPLACEMENT_AFTER_SALE_WITHIN_WINDOW: at least one replacement lot was acquired within 30 days after the sale.
reason_codes.DISALLOWED_LOSS_ADDED_TO_REPLACEMENT_BAS: the disallowed loss was added to the replacement lot's basis.
reason_codes.HOLDING_PERIOD_TACKED_TO_REPLACEMENT: at least one replacement lot's holding start was moved back to the sold lot's.
reason_codes.PARTIAL_REPLACEMENT_PRORATED_BY_SHARES: fewer replacement shares than loss shares, so the disallowance was prorated.
reason_codes.NO_REPLACEMENT_SHARES_IN_WINDOW: no replacement share was available in the window; the loss is recognized.
reason_codes.CROSS_ACCOUNT_REPLACEMENTS_OUT_OF_SCOPE: replacements in other accounts are not observable, so the disallowed loss is a lower bound and the recognized loss is an upper bound.
reason_codes.PER_EVENT_TAX_NOT_DEFINED_YEAR_LEVEL_NET: no per-event tax is defined: the registered estimator nets at year level after carry-in and cross-offset.
